RuleWhat happens
Save my spot and estimatesReminders on days 2, 7 and 21, then the lead closes itself
Installer offer24 hours to answer, then it lapses and Needs me says Choose again
Automatic installer offersWhen switched on: one installer covering the postcode (fewest active jobs, then nearest), 24 hours each; after 2 misses the job goes to Needs me
Automatic electrician offersWhen switched on: the installer’s usual electrician, else the nearest approved REC covering the postcode; same 24-hour rule
Install daysInstaller offers 3 days after the PIESA; owner takes one or suggests 1–5; one office alert at 10 days left
Deposit holdInstall day is provisional for 48 hours until the 10% deposit is in
Rebate formOwner asked at completion, reminded days 1, 3, 7; office alert on day 10
Privacy noticePer person, reminders days 3 and 7; can’t be on an install until acknowledged
30-day PIESA windowReminders at 20 and 10 days; a repeat PIESA is paid by whoever caused the delay
